home.title: Welcome
home.intro: This is the first skeleton of the conference hall management system. Hall plans, events and bookings will be added step by step.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.message: An unexpected error occurred while processing your request. Please try again later.

auth.secure: Your connection is encrypted; your password is never stored in plain text.

staffLogin.title: Admin sign in
staffLogin.subtitle: Sign in with your organisation account to manage halls, events and sales.
staffLogin.forgot: If you forgot your password, contact your organisation's administrator.
staffLogin.visualTitle: Plan your hall down to the centimetre.
staffLogin.visualText: Floor-plan editor, events, prices and sales in one panel. Everyone sees only the sections they are allowed to.

customerLogin.title: Welcome back
customerLogin.subtitle: Sign in to see your tickets and pick your seat in seconds.
customerLogin.visualTitle: The best seat is waiting for you.
customerLogin.visualText: See the hall on the floor plan, choose your place; your ticket is ready in seconds.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Sign up in a minute and grab your seat quickly at the next event.
register.consent: I agree to my personal data being processed for ticketing (KVKK).
register.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists.
register.passwordShort: The password must be at least {0} characters.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.intro: Sections granted to your role are shown as open. Sections will become available one by one.
admin.deniedTitle: You don't have access to this section
admin.deniedText: Your role does not include the permission this section needs. Ask your organisation's administrator for access.
admin.lastManager: After this change nobody active could manage users and roles. At least one active user must keep this permission.
admin.formErrors: Some fields need to be corrected.

salesScope.name: Sales permissions
salesScope.description: Choosing on the seating plan which seats each salesperson may sell.

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: Each role has the permissions ticked for it. A user can have several roles; their permissions add up.
roles.name: Role name
roles.permissionsHint: Users with this role can use the ticked sections. Changes take effect immediately.
roles.deleteConfirm: Delete this role? Users who have it lose its permissions.
roles.nameTaken: A role with this name already exists.
roles.systemNoDelete: A built-in system role cannot be deleted.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Organisation staff who can sign in to the admin panel. Ticket buyers are not listed here.
users.passwordNew: At least {0} characters. Share it with the user yourself.
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password.
users.passwordShort: The password must be at least {0} characters.
users.rolesHint: The user's permissions come from the selected roles.
users.isActiveHint: An inactive user's open session is closed immediately too.
users.emailTaken: Another user already has this email address.
users.selfDeactivate: You cannot deactivate your own account.
users.seatsRestricted: Seat restriction: can only sell the seats given to them
users.seatsRestrictedHint: If unchecked, a user who can sell may sell every seat. Seats are given on this screen:

halls.title: Halls
halls.intro: The halls where events take place, and their seating plans. Every time a plan is saved it is stored as a new version.
halls.name: Hall name
halls.descriptionHint: Optional; e.g. floor, building or a usage note.
halls.isActiveHint: An inactive hall cannot be chosen for new events; its plan and past events remain.
halls.newHint: The plan editor opens after you save.
halls.versionsHint: If you open an older version and save it, it becomes the current plan as a new version.
halls.empty: No halls yet. Start by adding the first hall and drawing its plan.
halls.nameRequired: Enter the hall name (up to 200 characters).
halls.nameTaken: Another hall already has this name.

hallPlan.invalid: The plan data is not valid, so it was not saved.
hallPlan.tooLarge: The plan is too large, so it was not saved.

planEditor.fit: Fit and centre the plan on screen (0)

hint.select: Click: select · Shift: add/remove · Click a selected group: key object for aligning · Alt+click: single seat inside a group · Drag on empty space: box select · Space: pan
hint.seat: Click to place a seat or an extra chair.
hint.row: Drag from the start of the row to its end. Curve bends the row into an arc facing the stage.
hint.grid: Drag a rectangle for the area the block will cover.

planEditor.levelNotEmpty: Remove the items on this level before deleting it.
planEditor.label: Label

alignTo.selection: To the selection bounds. Click a selected group to make it the key object.
alignTo.key: To the framed key object, which stays in place.

planEditor.keySet: Key object set: aligning will use it
planEditor.assignSel: Assign selected seats to this block
planEditor.noBlocks: No blocks on this level. Add a block to group seats.
planEditor.dataNote: Copy the plan as JSON or import another plan. An imported or loaded plan becomes a new version when you press Save.
planEditor.copyFail: Could not copy, select the text and copy it manually
planEditor.importFail: This text is not valid plan data
planEditor.saveTitle: Save (Ctrl+S): stored as a new version
planEditor.conflict: Someone else saved a new version in the meantime (version {n}). Your changes were not saved. Copy them from the JSON window, reload the page, import and save again.
planEditor.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
planEditor.oldVersion: Version {0} is open (current version is {1}). If you save, this becomes the current plan as a new version; older versions stay unchanged.

events.title: Events
events.intro: Events held in your halls and their sessions. Details are entered once; seats are sold separately for each session.
events.empty: No events yet. Add the first event and its sessions to get started.
events.organizerHint: Optional; e.g. an institution, group or person.
events.posterHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP; up to 5 MB. Portrait posters look best on the board.
events.saleModeReservationHint: Seats are reserved; free events or ones paid later.
events.saleModeSaleHint: Tickets are sold; prices come from seat categories.
events.requiresApprovalHint: If ticked, a reservation stays pending until authorised staff approve it.
events.onlineEnabledHint: If off, only staff can sell. Which seats are open online will be chosen in seat settings.
events.salesStartHint: If empty, sales open when the event is published.
events.salesEndHint: If empty, each session's sales close when it starts.
events.maxTicketsHint: How many tickets one person can get for a session; empty means no limit.
events.statusHint: Draft events are not shown on the board. Publishing needs at least one session.
events.sessionsHint: Enter the date and times of each session; add a row with + for more sessions. A new session is tied to the hall's current floor plan when it is saved; later plan changes do not affect its seating.
events.titleRequired: Enter the event name (up to 200 characters).
events.hallLocked: The hall cannot change once the event has sessions; they are tied to this hall's floor plan.
events.publishNeedsSession: Add at least one session before publishing.
events.salesEndBeforeStart: Sales must close after they open.
events.maxTicketsRange: Enter a number from 1 to 100, or leave it empty.
events.posterTooLarge: The poster can be at most 5 MB.
events.posterInvalid: The poster must be a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
events.sessionStartRequired: Enter the session date and start time.
events.hallHasNoPlan: This hall has no floor plan yet. Draw and save the hall's plan before adding sessions.
events.doorsAfterStart: Doors must open before the start time.

eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.intro: Types give new events their default sales type and approval rule; each event can change them.
eventTypes.name: Type name
eventTypes.defaultsHint: These values are only defaults for new events; existing events do not change.
eventTypes.nameRequired: Enter the type name (up to 100 characters).
eventTypes.nameTaken: Another type already has this name.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.intro: Ticket categories, prices and the seats open for online sale for each event.

seatMap.invalid: The seat settings could not be read. Reload the page and try again.
seatMap.tooLarge: The seat settings are too large.
seatMap.categoryName: Every category needs a name (up to 60 characters).
seatMap.categoryPrice: Price must be between 0 and 1,000,000 TRY.
seatMap.unknownSeat: The settings contain a seat that is not on the floor plan. Reload the page and try again.
seatMap.onlineProtocol: Protocol seats cannot be sold online.
seatMap.noSessions: This event has no sessions. Seat settings follow the floor plan a session is tied to; add a session first.

seatEditor.conflict: Someone else saved this event's seat settings in the meantime. Note your changes, reload the page and make them again.
seatEditor.saveFailed: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.
seatEditor.multiVersions: This event's sessions use different floor plan versions; the newest is shown. Settings apply to every session that has the same seats.
seatEditor.selHint: Click a seat; Shift-click to add or remove. Drag on an empty area to select a region.
seatEditor.catHint: Select seats and press a category's Assign button. Seats without a category or in a protocol category are not sold.
seatEditor.deleteCategoryConfirm: Delete “{name}”? {n} seats will have no category.
seatEditor.onlineHint: Only online seats can be bought or reserved online; staff sell the rest.
seatEditor.onlineDisabled: Online sales are off for this event. The selection is kept and applies once online sales are turned on.
seatEditor.onlineSkipped: {n} seats could not go online: no category or protocol.
seatEditor.settingsNote: Settings apply to every session of the event.
seatEditor.protocolTitle: Protocol seats are not for sale
seatEditor.reservationTitle: Reservation without a price: no price is entered or shown (e.g. if you don't want to show a price for online reservations)

salesScope.title: Sales permissions
salesScope.intro: Decide which seats each salesperson may sell. Staff without a restriction can sell every seat.
salesScope.sellersHint: Active users whose role allows selling. The seat restriction is switched on from the user edit page.
salesScope.noSellers: No active user can sell. Give the "Sales and reservations" permission to a role.
salesScope.hallsHint: Seats given for a hall apply to every event in that hall.
salesScope.eventsHint: If one event needs a different split, open an event-specific record; it replaces the hall's record for that event.

seatScope.noPlan: This hall has no seating plan yet. Draw the plan first.
seatScope.hallNote: Seats given here apply to every event in this hall (except events with their own record).
seatScope.eventUsesHallNote: This event currently uses the hall's record, shown below. Saving creates a separate record for this event; the hall's record stays as it is.
seatScope.eventSpecificNote: This event has its own record; the hall's record is not used for it.
seatScope.resetConfirm: Delete this event's own record and use the hall's record?
seatScope.staffHint: Staff who can sell a seat appear above it as a small label with their initials in their own colour. Click a name to bring their labels forward; the others fade. Select seats and press Give or Take. A seat can be given to several people (the label shows +1 and so on).
seatScope.giveTitle: Give the selected seats to this person
seatScope.takeTitle: Take the selected seats from this person
seatScope.noRestricted: No staff have a seat restriction. Salespeople with "Seat restriction" ticked on the user edit page are listed here.
seatScope.restrictHint: Use the user edit page to switch the restriction on or off.
seatScope.needSelection: Select seats on the plan first.
seatScope.invalid: The sales permission data could not be read.
seatScope.tooLarge: The sales permission data is too large.
seatScope.unknownSeat: There is a seat that is not on the plan. Reload the page and try again.
seatScope.unknownStaff: There is a user that is not in the list. Reload the page and try again.
seatScope.categoryPreviewNote: Seat colours come from the selected event's pricing. This is only a view and does not change sales permissions.
seatScope.noCategoriesHall: No categories have been defined for this hall's events yet, so seats are grey. Categories are defined on the Pricing screen.
seatScope.noCategoriesEvent: No categories have been defined for this event yet, so seats are grey. Categories are defined on the Pricing screen.

manage.description: Create events and link them to a hall and plan version.

manage.description: Ticket prices, price groups and seat categories.

sell.name: Sales and reservations
sell.description: Selling tickets and reserving seats. Which seats a person may sell can be limited per person.
